$comment: The source of sf-input-rich's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js), written in the standard 1.4 form of five authored files; standard simai.smart-component 1.3.11, vocabulary 1.1.5. Larena's request for an editor of its html@1 property type; owner approval q-6df38bf0d7.

size.summary: The field ladder, as sf-input's (1/3, 1/2, 1, 2, 3): the frame, the padding and the text of the same size; the toolbar's buttons a rung below (1/3 at 1/3).

appearance.summary: How the field looks: a bordered box or a filled one, sf-textarea's two boxes.

overflow.summary: What the toolbar does when its tools do not fit one row (owner decision C155, R233): more (the default) keeps one row and puts whole groups, with their separator, under ⋯ «Ещё» at its end -- undo and redo first, then the lists and the quote; the text levels and bold, italic, link stay; wrap lets the row wrap as before 1.6.0.

label.summary: The visible name of the field; it names the editing surface. Without it the host's aria-label does.

required.summary: The form is not sent while the value is empty (value-missing).

placeholder.summary: Shown while the field holds no text; said as aria-placeholder.

hint.summary: The line under the field; it describes the editing surface.

help.summary: The explanation behind a «?» (sf-help-mark, C133's look) after the label text (C153 (8)): a step below the value as the label; the label row keeps its height. The mark is named by its subject («Подробнее: <label>»). Empty: no mark.

name.summary: The form name the value is sent under.

rows.summary: The fewest lines the text area shows; it grows with the text.

max-rows.summary: The most lines before the text scrolls inside. Unset means no cap; a value below rows is rows.

maxlength.summary: The most characters the text should have, its markup not counted (C141 (1), sf-input-textarea's rule). The count shows from 80 % of it; past it the count and the frame turn to the error colour and the field is invalid (too-long), so the form is not sent. The text is never cut. Unset: no limit, no count.

counter.summary: With maxlength: the count shows always, not only from 80 % of the limit (C141 (1)).

disabled.summary: Not editable, not focusable and not sent with the form; a disabled fieldset does the same.

readonly.summary: Read and selected but not changed; the toolbar is disabled, the value is sent.

invalid.summary: The page's verdict: the error look and aria-invalid, with error-message under the field.

error-message.summary: Shown in place of the hint while invalid.

value.summary: HTML of the subset p, h2, h3, h4, strong, em, a[href], ul, ol, li, blockquote, br; href only https:, mailto:, tel: or a /path on the site. Cleaned when it is given and as it is edited; "" when there is no text.

input.summary: The text changed while it is edited: typing, a paste or a drop, a toolbar command, undo or redo; once per change, after the value is cleaned. The native event bubbles from the editing surface, which is its target.

change.summary: The value was committed: the person left the field with a value other than the one it had; a native Event from the editing surface, as a textarea's on leaving it.

relations.name: icon-buttons
$comment: The toolbar is the class markup of icon buttons, so the field owns
their roving tabindex and pressed state.

relations.name: cl-popover
$comment: The link editor: an sf-popover anchored to the link button, holding an

relations.name: cl-help-mark
$comment: The «?» after the label (help, owner decision C153 (8)) is sf-help-mark: fetched with the field.

relations.name: cl-menu-context
$comment: The levels menu and ⋯ «Ещё» open the standard menu (core/js/overflow-row.js, owner decision C155).

relations.name: buttons
$comment: The text levels are the class markup of a ghost button with its word and ▾ (C155 (5)).

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: The editing surface is role textbox, aria-multiline true, named by the label (aria-labelledby) or the host's aria-label, with aria-required, aria-readonly, aria-disabled, aria-invalid, aria-placeholder and aria-describedby the hint or error. The toolbar before it is role toolbar, named by the language file's toolbar word and controlling the surface: one Tab stop, the arrows, Home and End move between its buttons (roving tabindex), each button says aria-pressed where it toggles and aria-keyshortcuts where it has one. Tab in the text leaves the field; it never inserts a tab. The text levels are one menu button (aria-haspopup menu, named «Уровень текста: Абзац») and ⋯ «Ещё» another, both stops of the roving row; Enter, Space or the down arrow opens the standard menu, the levels a radio group, ⋯ the tools that left with their shortcuts and a check for a pressed one (owner decision C155 (5), (6)).

x-summary: A form field for formatted text: paragraphs, headings 2 to 4, bold, italic, links, bulleted and numbered lists and quotes, with a toolbar, undo and redo. Its value is HTML of that subset and nothing else: the value it is given, every paste and drop and every edit are cleaned to it.

x-source.brief: Larena's request for an editor of the html@1 property type (sanitized HTML subset); owner approval q-6df38bf0d7

x-decisions: name: sf-rich-text (owner approval q-6df38bf0d7). A leaf of the field family: the value is a string, the host is the form control through ElementInternals as sf-textarea's, so a form submits the HTML under name and reset puts the value attribute back.

subset: js/rich-text-html.mjs is the one rule, used for the value given, a paste or drop and the surface after every edit. Two readers feed one cleaner -- the browser's parser in an inert <template> where there is a document, a small tolerant string reader where there is none (tests, a server) -- and the output is written from the cleaned model with every text escaped, so it holds nothing off the subset whatever a reader understood.

unwrap, never lose text: an element off the subset is replaced by its text; script, style and the other containers of code, a document's head, drawings and form controls' data (DROPPED) go with their content. An element off the subset that stands as a block (div, section, h1, a table cell, pre) still separates its text from its neighbours', so pasted documents keep their paragraphs.

marks from styles: b and i are strong and em; a word processor's span with a bold or italic style is too, and a b with font-weight normal is not (the wrapper a document editor puts around a whole paste). Only the style's weight and style are read; no attribute survives.

links: https:, mailto:, tel: and a /path on the site; http: is not in the list Larena asked for. The scheme is judged with control characters and white space removed. A link whose href fails becomes its text, on load, paste and in the link editor, which refuses it with the language file's link-invalid word.

normalised value: text outside a block is a p, a block inside a paragraph splits it, a block inside a list item becomes a line of it, a list holds only items, adjacent lists of one kind are one list; no empty block, no line break at a block's edge, nesting a > strong > em; an editor without text is "". The editing surface keeps an empty paragraph's
so the caret has a line, and is cleaned with the same rule in its own mode.

commands: blocks, lists and quotes are the component's own DOM operations; bold and italic set their marks themselves (1.3.1: the browser's command read the computed style as the mark, so a heading, bold by its type, took none), and the result is cleaned like any edit; at a caret the mark waits for the typed text. Undo and redo are the component's own history of cleaned states with the caret, typing grouped by the second, so neither depends on the browser's undo stack, which a cleaned surface would break.

events: input and change are the native names (§8, §17.3), as sf-textarea's. input once per change after cleaning -- the browser's own input during a command is held back and the command says it once; change when focus leaves the field with a changed value, since a contenteditable has none of its own. Moving between the toolbar, the link editor and the text is not leaving.

toolbar: the class markup of icon buttons (as sf-dropdown and the inherited-value reset draw theirs), so the roving tabindex, aria-pressed and aria-disabled are the field's own attributes in one render; an sf-icon-button host copies its attributes onto its button on its own schedule. Block level is four toggle buttons (paragraph, heading 2, 3, 4) rather than a select: one keyboard model for the whole toolbar, and a select inside a toolbar would be a second form-associated field. Unavailable tools (undo with nothing to undo, a heading inside a list) are aria-disabled and stay reachable.

link editor: sf-popover anchored to the link button, the form's width step (C32), on a phone a sheet at the bottom of the screen lifted into the top layer, holding an sf-input (text, no name, so it is never sent and never blocks the form) and sf-button Apply and Remove link; Enter applies, Escape closes. Its input and change stop at the panel: they are not the field's.

geometry: the frame is sf-textarea's -- the hairline, --sf-radius--ui, the padding calc of each size and the focus ring on the frame -- and the toolbar's buttons are one rung below the field (1/3, 1/2, 1 for sizes 1/2, 1, 2), a block level's text in the glyph's square; headings in the text are the field's text ladder (h2 a rung above the field's text, h3 the field's, h4 a rung below). rows sets the least height in the size's lines, max-rows the most before the text scrolls.

a11y: role textbox with aria-multiline on the editing surface, named by the label or the host's aria-label; toolbar role toolbar with aria-controls. Colours are role tokens only: on-surface on surface-0 and surface-container, the icon button's own pressed look for a pressed tool (on-primary-container on primary-container, C12), on-surface-variant for the hint, placeholder and quotes, error for the error line -- the pairs the theme makes AA in light and dark.
css-variables: seven public variables in sf-textarea's pattern (§6), listed in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json.

version 1.0.1: the bare editor keeps a page's unlayered :focus-visible outline off with outline: none !important -- an unlayered rule beats every layered one, and drew a second frame inside the frame's ring (owner, 2026-11-01). The frame's ring is unchanged.

version 1.0.3: the editor is unchanged. The subset module it carries (core/js/composition/html-subset.mjs) gains the paste profile of a structured-content editor, cleanTree(tree, {profile: 'paste'}), which keeps pre and simple tables as blocks of their own (simai/ui-source#66); html@1 and every value this editor writes stay as they were.

version 1.1.0: the tag is sf-input-rich (naming decision 2026-11-02: sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>]); the folder, the id smart.input-rich and the bundle cl-input-rich follow it. sf-rich-text stays a dated alias until 2027-01-01: a subclass the Smart base defines beside the new tag, listed in the rule, in sheets as :is(sf-input-rich, sf-rich-text) (change journal tag-sf-rich-text-to-sf-input-rich, path-smart-rich-text-to-input-rich).

version 1.1.1 (2026-11-08): a patch, nothing drawn differently by this element. Its first-paint sheet list names the kbd sheet (component.kbd 1.1.0, docs review R030): sf-button 1.8.0 draws a shortcut's keys with it, and every component that draws an sf-button asks for it before the first paint. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.1.2 (2026-11-08): a patch, nothing drawn differently by this element. Its first-paint snapshots follow the actions block (docs review R031, R032; decisions C13-C15): the sf-button and sf-button-icon it draws ask for the screen-reader-only utility sheet (sf-button 1.9.0, sf-button-icon 1.7.0), an sf-button-close it draws asks for its own sheet (C14), and sf-input's classes follow its outer sizes (sf-input 1.6.0). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.
version 1.2.0 (2026-11-09): the field is transparent at rest, so it stands on any place (C16, the background system, owner 2026-11-08).

version 1.3.0 (2026-11-10, docs precheck RT-01, RT-02, RT-04, RT-06): a minor, the toolbar, the headings and the link editor drawn by the systems. The block levels P, H2, H3 and H4 stand in the glyph's square, the button rung's line, so they are the icon buttons' square beside them (32 x 32 at size 1 on a desktop, 28 x 28 on a phone; they were 21-32 x 26). The toolbar's buttons are ghost on-surface, the editor toolbar's look of decision C15 (sf-icon-button--ghost; they wrote link, ghost's old name), and a pressed tool wears the icon button's own pressed look (C12: primary container); the field drew secondary container under the icon button's on-primary-container ink. Headings in the text climb the text ladder from the field's own text, as the page's heading ladder does (C21: the size never falls down the levels, no heading smaller than the text): h4 the field's text, h3 a rung above, h2 two rungs above, bold, each with its rung's line (size 1: 24/36, 20/28, 16/24 on 16/24 text on a desktop, 18/24, 16/24, 14/20 on 14/20 text on a phone; they were the page's 32/36 and down). The link editor is a form in a popup: the wide form's width step (C32), and on a phone (below 44rem) a sheet at the bottom of the screen, the screen's width up to 44rem, over the scrim, lifted into the top layer (C32 addendum, as sf-menu-context draws a form); at 390 it hung 150 px off the screen. The form is one rung (R121): the address field, its label and hint, and Apply / Remove are the field's size capped at 1 (the buttons were a rung below the field), and the surface's edge and the room before the actions are one step, --sf-space-1; the wide form's step (--sf-popup-form-wide-width, 24rem, compact 22rem) keeps the field's-size Apply and Remove in one row. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged. The text's padding is unchanged (RT-05): the block padding is the size's tightness step less the hairline, as sf-textarea's and sf-input's, so the text stands one step from the frame's edge. The C16 leftovers' note for 1.2.1 (a pressed toolbar tool wears the icon button's own pressed look; the toolbar's secondary-container rule is gone, C19) ships in this release: 1.2.1 is never released (pair next 2 integration).

version 1.3.1 (2026-11-11): a patch, nothing drawn differently. Bold is pressed by the bold mark only: in a heading (bold by its type) the caret no longer presses it. The browser's bold state and command read the computed weight, so in h2-h4 Bold showed pressed on every word and Ctrl/Cmd+B or the button took no mark; the component now sets the mark itself (all the selected text marked: the mark comes off, otherwise it goes on), and at a caret the mark waits for the typed text. Bold and Italic set their marks themselves everywhere, not by the browser's command: at a caret in a paragraph Ctrl/Cmd+B then typing also took no mark (the browser's typing style was lost when the edit put the caret back), and Italic had the same caret defect. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.2 (2026-11-11, retired tokens w2; a patch on the released 1.3.1), nothing drawn differently. The sheet reads the C16 roles by their current names where it read the former ones, which are var() of them wherever they are declared (src/core/contracts/token-aliases.v1.json, sf-role-aliases): --sf-disable → --sf-surface-disabled; --sf-on-disable → --sf-on-surface-disabled ×4; --sf-on-surface-container--variant → --sf-on-surface-container-variant; --sf-outline-disable → --sf-outline-disabled. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.2, also (2026-11-11, IME follow-ups and the rich toolbar square; written on the branch's 1.3.1): a patch. Text composed with an IME (compositionend) takes the pending marks as typed text does (acceptance R1: the composed text stayed plain). The IME follow-ups (acceptance M1-M4, E1): a composition keeps the pending marks while it runs, so Bold and Italic stay pressed, and a cancelled one (no text, the caret back) keeps them for the next typing; every composition that changed the text is followed by exactly one input that is not composing, marks or none (a browser that says the commit itself is that one); plain text pasted at the caret takes the pending marks as typing does, rich text keeps its own; a caret on a mark's end edge (at the block's level right after a bold run, or at the start of the text after it) goes to the end of the mark's text, where the browser types, so Bold reads the place the text goes (C12). The link editor stands on the toolbar's rung (owner review R121): its address field, the field's label and hint, and Apply / Remove take the link button's size (1/3, 1/2, 1 at the field sizes 1/2, 1, 2; they were the field's size capped at 1), so the form is the toolbar's scale. While the link editor is open the link tool is the only one that looks active: the other tools draw at rest, with no pressed, hover or focus fill and no filled glyph, and keep aria-pressed. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.2, also (2026-11-11, owner decision C52 with C41's 8 % fill): appearance="filled" draws its bottom edge in --sf-outline at rest (--sf-rich-text-border-color colours it too); hover colours the line with the border, focus turns the whole border --sf-outline as before; error and disabled have no line.

version 1.3.2, also (2026-11-10, composition review F1.4; written as 1.2.1, which is never released): a patch. Cleaning a value is idempotent: a run of only white space ( ) beside a line break at a block's edge hid the break from the first pass, so

 
a

was stored as


a

and became

a

on the next load-and-save with no edit. The edges are now trimmed until stable; the value is the old second pass at once. Every other value is the same bytes (corpus tests/fixtures/html1-break-corpus.json). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.3 (2026-11-13, a patch on the released 1.3.2): sf-input-rich's own code, sheet, settings, values, events and keys are unchanged; what moved is its first paint and what it shows through sf-popover 1.6.0 (C59 stage S1). The eight first-paint snapshots (static/default: cleaned, disabled, empty, filled, invalid, readonly, reference, size-2) are retaken: the link tool's button now carries aria-controls naming the link editor's panel (sf-input-rich-<snapshot>-<n>), as the live drawing does since the popover says aria-controls on its trigger when the surface has an id, so a server-printed field and a drawn one announce the same relation. Through the popover the link editor opens in the browser's top layer: an ancestor's overflow: hidden, a scroll container, a z-index, a transform or contain no longer clip or cover it, it flips and shifts at the window's edges, and the phone sheet is held in the top layer while it is open; its place, size and look are otherwise as in 1.3.2.

version 1.4.0 (2026-11-14, fields ladder; study control/research/2026-11-14-textarea-rich-text.md TR-1, TR-3, TR-15): a minor (1.3.3 is taken by integration-fix/reds-4). size takes the field ladder's five steps, 1/3, 1/2, 1, 2, 3 (toolbar buttons 1/3 at 1/3 and 2 at 3, the link editor on the toolbar's rung). The text starts where sf-input-textarea's does (C77): 12 / 16 / 20 from the frame's outer edge at 1/2, 1, 2 (12 / 12 / 16 compact, 12 / 12 / 16 on a phone; 19 / 37 at 1/3 and 3, as sf-input), where it drew 22 / 25 / 31 (phone 19 / 21 / 27); the frame takes the textarea's corner rule. On a touch phone the text and the headings are at least 16px on at least the size-1 line, so iOS does not zoom into the field (it drew 12 and 14px). A required field left empty shows its required error once the form's check fails, as sf-input-textarea 1.8.0 (C55 F1): the error frame, aria-invalid and «Заполните поле» under it, gone once there is text; the word value-missing is the textarea's («Заполните поле» / «Fill in this field»; it was «Введите текст.»). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged. Owner decision C141 (2026-11-14; study TR-4, TR-6, TR-7, TR-9, TR-10) in the same minor: (1) the new maxlength and counter count the text a person reads (the value without its markup) with sf-input-textarea's rule (src/smart/helpers/char-count.js, sf-chat-composer's): the count at the end of the message line from 80 % of the limit (always with counter), past the limit the count and the frame in the error colour and the host invalid (too-long), the text kept whole, a polite line at a threshold. (3) The toolbar sticks to the top of the visible part of the field (position sticky, --sf-rich-text-sticky-top, opaque on the field's fill over the place's solid surface). (4) The toolbar's groups stand in the order of importance and carry data-sf-priority 1 (text levels; bold, italic, link), 2 (lists, quote), 3 (undo, redo); the «More» control for what does not fit waits for its study (R233), so the row still wraps. (5) A read-only field draws no toolbar: the text stands in the read-only frame (a record card already shows the value as text, module.smart-field-renderers). (6) The link editor: the address field and both buttons are size 1/2 at every field size (they followed the toolbar's rung: 1/3 at 1/2, 1 at 2, 2 at 3), the buttons in one row from the start edge, «Применить» first, the panel's inset and the room above the buttons --sf-space-1/2 (the dropping panel's, C106; they were --sf-space-1). (7) Headings in the text stand one level below the page's (h2 the page's h3, h3 its h4, h4 its h5) and never below the field's own climb from its text. In the same minor, OV-11 (C105 H5, dispatcher ruling C144; study control/research/2026-11-14-toolbar-overflow.md): the toolbar's icon buttons of one group stand --sf-space-1/4 apart (4), where they stood edge to edge, with --sf-space-1/4 on each side of a group's separator line as before; the link editor's two buttons stand --sf-space-1/3 apart (8; 4 compact), one group (C105 H5).

version 1.7.0 (2026-11-14, owner decision C153; research ui-control control/research/2026-11-14-text-inputs.md, prototype prototypes/text-inputs-study.html; written on the branch as 1.5.0): a minor. The label is in the text ink a step below the value (14 on a phone at size 1), the required «*» in the label's ink and hidden from assistive technology; hover draws the border in the text ink; focus by mouse or keys draws a 2 px primary edge inside the frame, no outer ring, no shift (R242). The field shows its own errors as sf-input does (C153 (3), helpers/form-field.js): a failed check of the form shows every wrong field at once and the first takes the focus when the person submitted; afterwards, once the value was changed, leaving the field checks it; a shown error goes the moment the value is right; the words are the component's, in the page's language; the browser's bubble is cancelled. New setting help (C153 (8)): sf-help-mark after the label and its «*», a step below the value, held to the label's line so the row keeps its height, named «Подробнее: <label>» (lang help).

version 1.6.1 (2026-11-14, owner decision C173; numbered above 1.6.0 on an open branch): a patch; nothing this element draws or reads changed. The toolbar stands the role token --sf-gap--toolbar apart and the link window's two buttons --sf-gap--actions (C173), the steps --sf-space-1/4 and --sf-space-1/3 they stood on. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.6.2 (2026-11-14, owner decisions C173 point 7 and C181 (3), the layer roles): a patch. The phone link sheet reads the popover layer (--sf-layer--popover, 90, as before). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.8.0 (2026-11-14, one above fix/text-inputs-c153's 1.5.0; owner decision C155 (1), (4), (5), (6), (8); R233, study ui-control control/research/2026-11-14-toolbar-overflow.md, prototype prototypes/toolbar-overflow-study.html; written on the branch as 1.6.0): a minor. (4) New setting overflow, more by default: the toolbar keeps one row and what does not fit leaves for ⋯ «Ещё» at its end, everywhere it does not fit, not only on a phone -- whole groups with their separator, the highest data-sf-priority first (undo, redo, then the lists and the quote), the groups of priority 1 (the text levels; bold, italic, link) stay. An emptied group takes no place: the group, its separator and ⋯'s separator while nothing left are out of the row (display none), so no gaps add up (the study prototype's 12). ⋯ is an icon button of the toolbar's rung and look (ghost on-surface, more_horiz) named and titled «Ещё» / «More» (lang more), a stop of the roving row after the last tool shown, with a separator before it; it opens the standard sf-menu-context (lazy) listing the tools that left in the row's order, groups split by separators, each with its icon, name and shortcut (mod+…), a pressed one checked (6); ⋯ itself never shows pressed. A row of the menu runs the tool's command. The arithmetic is the shared row engine (core/js/overflow-row.js layoutActionRow), laid out in a resize observer of the frame and the groups before paint; until laid out the row clips and never wraps. overflow="wrap" keeps 1.4.0's wrapping row. (5) The four level buttons P, H2, H3, H4 are one menu button first in the row: the current level's word and ▾ (class markup of a ghost on-surface button on the toolbar's rung), named «Уровень текста: <level>» (lang text-level), opening a radio menu Абзац, Заголовок 2, 3, 4 with the current one chosen; in a list it is unavailable, as the four were. The roving row's first stop is the levels button; the arrows skip what is out of the row; the down arrow opens a menu button (APG menu button); in a right-to-left row the right arrow goes back. At 260 px (size 1) the toolbar is one row: «Абзац», bold, italic, link, ⋯ (it wrapped onto two rows in 1.4.0). Values, events and the commands unchanged.

version 1.8.1 (2026-11-14, owner decision C184 (1)-(3); study control/research/2026-11-14-toolbar-menu-open.md; written on the branch as 1.7.0): a minor, above fix/overflow-c155's 1.6.x. The toolbar's keys are core's roving helper (core/js/roving.js), not a copy of their own: the toolbar is one Tab stop and Tab comes back to the tool the person left; the arrows follow the row's direction, so in a right-to-left page ← moves forward (TL-6); Home and End go to the ends and the walk wraps. An unavailable tool (undo with nothing to undo, a text level in a list) stays dimmed and in the walk, and says why as its tooltip and description: new words nothing-to-undo «Нечего отменять», nothing-to-redo «Нечего повторять», not-in-list «Недоступно в списке» (C184 (2), as C164 (4) for a menu row). Settings, values and events unchanged.

version 1.10.1 (2026-11-17, feat/lang-file-c282; numbered above 1.10.0 on origin/fix/layer-order-c273): a patch. Russian is a language file (owner decision C282, 2026-11-17): the bundle carries the English words only (lang/index.mjs, written by scripts/build-language-packs.mjs from src/core/lang/built-in.json); the Russian ones come from core/lang/ru.js included before core, or from the ru part of its family that core fetches, and SF.Loader holds the definition until that part is here (at most 800 ms). A page with the language file draws the same Russian as before; lang/ru.json is unchanged.

The component's fill, edge colour, text colour and the place roles it declares stand in the new cascade layer sf.paint, under the utilities, so a bg-*, border-* or color-* class on it or on one of its parts now paints it; its size, padding, radius, height and edge width stay in sf.components, over the utilities. aria-label.description: Accessible name for a field drawn without a visible label; it names the editing surface. A visible label wins.

html_subset.const: p h2 h3 h4 strong em a[href] ul ol li blockquote br

forbidden_client_responsibilities: trusting the value without the server's own sanitizer

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-input-rich for formatted text a person writes in a form -- a page's text, a description, an announcement -- stored as the HTML subset of Larena's html@1 type.
do_not: Do not trust the submitted value on the server: clean it there with the same subset
Do not use it for one line of text or for code; use sf-input, sf-textarea or sf-code-input
Do not put the value into a page with innerHTML without a sanitizer: render it through the server's cleaned copy or SF.sanitizeHtml
Do not add tags or attributes to the subset in a product; ask for a change of the html@1 type

keyboard: Tab reaches the toolbar (one stop) and then the text; Tab in the text leaves the field
ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home and End move between the toolbar's buttons
Mod+B and Mod+I toggle bold and italic, Mod+K opens the link editor
Mod+Z undoes, Mod+Shift+Z and Mod+Y redo
Enter in the link editor applies, Escape closes it
accessibility.focus: The frame draws the focus ring while the text has keyboard focus; a click into the text draws none. Toolbar commands keep the caret and the selection in the text; the link editor takes focus when it opens and gives the caret back to the text when it closes.

runCommand.summary: Runs a toolbar command on the current selection: paragraph, heading-2, heading-3, heading-4, bold, italic, link (opens the link editor), bulleted-list, numbered-list, quote, undo, redo. The result is cleaned, recorded for undo and said with input. Returns whether it ran (false while disabled or read-only).

undo.summary: Steps back one cleaned state and says input; false when there is nothing to undo.

redo.summary: Steps forward one cleaned state and says input; false when there is nothing to redo.
